knowledge.plain_language_summary: An internally illuminated vehicular wayfinding directory: a SignComp Architectural Series 7 hinge-body cabinet with push-through acrylic and a raised logo cabinet (flex-face), set on a modular red-brick base with a limestone cap and an engineered concrete footing.
knowledge.rationale: A SignComp extruded cabinet on a mason-built brick/limestone base ties the sign to campus architecture; push-through acrylic and a flex-face logo carry the lit content.

structure.construction: SignComp Arch Series 7 hinge body with 7in radius post-end caps painted MP Dark Green, 1/8in aluminum face panels, lower removable panels with push-through #7328 acrylic (1/8in proud), US LED internal white LED
raised corner logo cabinet 10in deep, 3M flex-face on tension frame
4in limestone cap + modular red-brick base (mason-built), engineered concrete footing with leveling bolts; electrical stub through base; photocell + timer

materials_manifest.product: Matthews MP Dark Green; MP27386 Verizon White; MP18076 Silver Cup Metallic

craft_observations: SignComp extruded cabinet on mason-built brick/limestone base ties sign to campus architecture.
Fabricator coordinates electrical stub through the masonry base.
